description: This PHP file defines search fields configuration for the 'Meetings' module in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM customization. It specifies query parameters, filters, range searches, and subqueries for filtering meetings based on various criteria.
calls: SELECT favorites.parent_id FROM favorites WHERE favorites.deleted = 0 and favorites.parent_type = 'Meetings' and favorites.assigned_user_id = '{1}'
